```yaml
name: Devx Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  devx_tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # fetch all tags

      - name: Configure git remote with token
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Set up Git user
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create dev tag
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Find the latest release tag (e.g., v1.2.3)
          RELEASE_TAG=$(git tag -l 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | head -n1)
          if [ -z "$RELEASE_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No release tags found. Skipping dev tag creation."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Latest release tag: $RELEASE_TAG"

          # Find existing dev tags for this release
          EXISTING_TAGS=$(git tag -l "${RELEASE_TAG}.dev*" | sort -V)
          if [ -z "$EXISTING_TAGS" ]; then
            NEXT=1
          else
            LAST_TAG=$(echo "$EXISTING_TAGS" | tail -n1)
            echo "Last dev tag: $LAST_TAG"
            NUM=$(echo "$LAST_TAG" | sed -n "s/.*\.dev\([0-9]\+\)/\1/p")
            if [ -z "$NUM" ]; then
              NEXT=1
            else
              NEXT=$((NUM + 1))
            fi
          fi

          NEW_TAG="${RELEASE_TAG}.dev${NEXT}"
          echo "Creating new dev tag: $NEW_TAG"

          MAX_RETRIES=3
          RETRY=0
          while [ $RETRY -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
            # If tag already exists locally, increment and retry
            if git rev-parse "$NEW_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Tag $NEW_TAG already exists locally. Incrementing."
              NEXT=$((NEXT + 1))
              NEW_TAG="${RELEASE_TAG}.dev${NEXT}"
              echo "Trying new tag: $NEW_TAG"
              RETRY=$((RETRY + 1))
              continue
            fi

            git tag -a "$NEW_TAG" -m "dev tag $NEW_TAG"
            if git push origin "$NEW_TAG" --force-with-lease; then
              echo "Tag $NEW_TAG pushed successfully."
              exit 0
            else
              echo "Failed to push tag $NEW_TAG. Retrying."
              NEXT=$((NEXT + 1))
              NEW_TAG="${RELEASE_TAG}.dev${NEXT}"
              RETRY=$((RETRY + 1))
            fi
          done

          echo "Failed to create dev tag after $MAX_RETRIES attempts."
          exit 1
```
